Best Sunday Roast in Town
Jan 2019 • Couples
The Sunday roast at D2 Sports Bar is exceptional. Super hot and particularly tasty. Each week offers a different meat for Sunday roast but for a little extra you can change your meat to one of your choice. I normally elect for the chicken which is beautifully sliced , the best white meat part of the chicken and plentiful. The veggies are varied and cooked to perfection and the mashed potato is the best in Ho Chi Minh - a correct texture mashed with real butter that you can taste. The gray is delicious too and completes the wonderful roast experience. If I have one small complaint it is that the roast potatoes are soft on the outside and lack that crispness normally associated with roast potatoes but they do not spoil an otherwise delicious experience. There is a good range of wines on offer too to complement the meal. The Sunday roast is deserving of a 5 star rating but I have settled on a 4 star rating for the restaurant overall when taking into account other meals eaten there during the week. For example, the french fries are delightful - to a nice thickness and piping hot, crispy on the outside and soft and fluffy on the outside. But I find the minced beef and pie a little too dry, although it is served with a tasty gravy on the side, and there is an overriding taste of herbs, not normally associated with a beef pie. But for a Sunday roast? In this realm D2 Sports Bar cannot be beaten . We have tried all the Sunday roasts in town and whilst one or two are very good, D2 Sports Bar Sunday roasts are in a class of their own.

All Blacks vs British and Irish Lions
Jul 2017
So this was the decider, the teams were equal, 1 win each.
I met up with my long term friend, a Kiwi, at the Dtwo Sports Pub in District 2. I arrived around 1pm, and the crowd was building. As an Aussie, I was one of the few independent spectators.
The Dtwo is a long and relatively narrow pub, and not really ideal for a big crowd. Fortunately, I was early enough to grab 2 seats at the bar, and settled in. The menu is strictly pub grub, so I ordered Chilli Con Carne. My mate had Eggs Benedict. Not sure how the eggs were, but the Chilli was a variation on the theme in the presentation. Chilli on a plate (as opposed to a bowl), brown rice, a small bowl of salsa, and some taco chips. All in all, very good. By kick-off time, our food was finished, and the crowd was big. Service for the patrons that were standing was hit and miss, we were glad that we had front row seats.
For the record, the score ended up a 15 all draw.
All in all, a happy afternoon.

Probably the Best Family Pub in Saigon
Jan 2017 • Friends
If you miss a UK pub lunch in a couple or family-friendly location, this is a great choice.

Unlike Bangkok, Saigon is not spoiled for British / Irish pubs. I'm therefore really happy to have the British-managed D2 Sports Pub Down the road from my house.

The bar is clean, modern and comfortable, and the menu consists of authentic pub grub at fair prices. I can personally vouch for the all-day breakfast and Sunday roast. Most nights they have a special, such as curry night and burger night. The beer and cider selection is also decent for Saigon, and house wine is well-priced.

The pub is non-smoking, but there is a terrace outside - even as a smoker, I don't mind, since I see this place as a family pub rather than a drinking den.

If you are feeling homesick for the Weatherspoons experience, give this authentic pub a try.

Pub Grub and Sports Haven
Nov 2016 • Family
The new menu offers all the classic pub grub favorites and the portions are huge and great value. They have beef roast dinners all week for 250,000vnd and pub lunch specials for 145,000vnd, plus authentic all day English Breakfasts with great sausage and real back bacon. The Sunday Roast specials are their signature offer at only 200,000vnd and they rotate from lamb, beef, chicken or pork with all the trimmings and condiments. Hugely popular so get down early especially on the lamb days as they sell out fast. All sports are covered from 10am till 1am such as English Football, Rubgy, Cricket, Boxing, Aussy Rules and A league etc, or 8am at weekends for UFC and earlier events and both live games or repeats are available on request. Multiple screens and networks make it possible to watch any sport at any time. Huge variety of ice cold draft and bottled beers, ciders and wines. No smoking inside offers a family friendly atmosphere and a new kids menu will be on offer soon. Food for everyone. Pool table and darts board inside also. Delivery available from 10am till 9pm.
